title: Victory Dance After the Winning Goal ⚽🏆
script: The whistle blows. We won. You don't remember the last two minutes. Time stopped. Everything you ever doubted — gone. Your team just won the World Cup. You grab whoever's closest. You dance. You cry. You scream. You are not alone — millions are doing exactly what you're doing right now. We did it. We actually did it. This is the greatest feeling on earth.
prompt_for_hailuo: Young woman with long straight black hair, gold and white team jersey, running onto the field level celebrating with the crowd as confetti cannons fire [Wide shot, stadium erupting, golden confetti everywhere, player silhouettes in background]. She spins with arms wide open, pure elation, tears streaming down her smiling face [Tracking shot spinning with her, confetti falling like snow]. Second clip: she grabs two strangers and the three of them jump up and down hugging and dancing together [Push in on the three friends jumping, tears and smiles, golden stadium lights blazing]. Fireworks exploding overhead, trophy visible in distance, euphoric crowd, golden cinematic lighting, 9:16 portrait.
